Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int countSubstrings(string s) {
        int N = s.size();
        int count = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            for (int j = i; j < N; j++)
            {
                int curLen = j - i + 1;
                if (isValidPar(s.substr(i, curLen)))
                    count++;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }
    bool isValidPar(string str)
    {
        string temp(str);
        reverse(str.begin(), str.end());
        return temp == str;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    string s = "abc";
    auto res = sol.countSubstrings(s);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
